question: When primitive boundary types and the complete local typed-edge inventory are held fixed, does breaking the frozen relation class between learned depth-1 V8 modules damage hierarchical compression more than a matched module-instance rewire that preserves that recursive relation class?

designContext.priorV2Pattern: both reused evaluation lanes had positive mean typed-selective penalties and significant sign-flip tests, while the frozen flat comparator moved in the opposite direction; holdout missed the preregistered positive-fraction gate
designContext.interpretiveStatus: post-result mechanistic follow-up under the unchanged frozen V8 grammar; not fresh independent validation
designContext.refinement: V3 asks whether the divergence between hierarchical and flat behavior is specifically carried by composition among learned nonterminal modules rather than by primitive typed-edge inventory alone.

trainFeasibilityPilot.purpose: freeze feasibility and support requirements before V3 evaluation

parentV8.depth1Closure: apply every frozen hierarchical rule with depth=1 in original grammar order while skipping deeper rules
parentV8.upperGrammar: after depth1 closure, apply every frozen hierarchical rule with depth>=2 in original grammar order

population.laneReuseNote: holdout/control were opened by prior experiments before V3 was designed; V3 reuses them only as frozen mechanistic evaluation lanes

matchedIntervention.unit: one observation after frozen depth-1 closure
matchedIntervention.candidateSelection: deterministic minimum SHA-256 among valid candidates
matchedIntervention.endpointRequirement: all four selected residual endpoints must be learned nonterminal symbols whose frozen derivation depth is exactly 1
matchedIntervention.selectedResidualEdgeRequirement: each selected residual node pair must contain exactly one residual edge so its frozen pair key is unambiguous
edgePairCriteria: both canonical degree-preserving half-edge rewires create nonduplicate non-self residual relationships
both rewires preserve the selected primitive boundary typed-edge signature
exactly one rewire preserves the selected frozen depth-1 residual pair-key signature and the other breaks it
matchedIntervention.primitiveBoundaryTypedEdgeSignature: multiset over the two selected edges of (complete edge label, unordered terminal-leaf symbol pair reached by the frozen residual ports)
matchedIntervention.recursiveRelationSignature: multiset over the two selected edges of the exact canonical V8 residual pair key: endpoint depth-1 nonterminal symbols plus complete edge label plus endpoint port paths
matchedIntervention.compositionPreservingRewire: change exact module-instance adjacency while preserving both primitive boundary typed-edge signature and recursive relation signature
matchedIntervention.compositionBreakingRewire: change exact module-instance adjacency while preserving primitive boundary typed-edge signature but changing the recursive relation signature
requiredExactLocalStageInvariantsAcrossO: complete residual half-edge inventory of node, port path, and edge label
requiredExactExpandedPrimitiveInvariants: expanded terminal leaf identities and terminal symbols

outcome.instrument: unchanged frozen V8 grammar; no rule refit, reordering, threshold tuning, or candidate redefinition after evaluation
outcome.primaryPerObservation: hierarchy increment = full hierarchical selective penalty - flat selective penalty
outcome.positiveMeaning: breaking relations among learned depth-1 modules selectively harms recursive hierarchical compression beyond the frozen flat/local dictionary
outcome.localRawSelectivePenalty: must be exactly zero by invariant before any upper-order grammar is applied

null.test: deterministic sign flips of each observation's normalized hierarchy increment within lane

adjudication.RECURSIVE_COMPOSITION_SUPPORTED: all holdout and control support, direction, hierarchy-increment, upper-only, fraction, and sign-flip gates pass
adjudication.RECURSIVE_COMPOSITION_NOT_DISTINGUISHED: support is sufficient but at least one preregistered gate fails; do not rescue by changing module depth, local signature, recursive signature, grammar, comparator, or thresholds after the result
adjudication.INFEASIBLE: either evaluation lane has fewer than its frozen minimum eligible matched interventions

falsifier: If breaking the exact frozen relation class among learned depth-1 modules does not create a positive hierarchical-over-flat penalty while primitive boundary types and local typed-edge inventory remain fixed in both reused evaluation lanes, V3 does not support a recursive-composition layer beyond local typed relationships.
claimBoundary: A pass would support the mechanistic claim that the frozen V8 representation contains reusable composition among learned local modules that carries compression value beyond the flat/local dictionary on these reused evaluation lanes. It would not be fresh independent confirmation, establish historical semantics, prove conscious encoding, establish universality, or show that the learned modules are a final ontology.
